name: numeric-conversion-test-6b3e1e5e00/infinite-float-union-as-byte-p.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: Literal — Currently support `nil-literal`, `boolean-literal`, `numeric-literal` and `string-literal` only
reason: The case computes floating-point infinity with supported division, stores it in a float|boolean union, and expects the byte type cast to panic. Type casts and numeric division are explicitly supported without a restriction excluding union operands, non-finite floats, or failed numeric casts. All constructs and the asserted cast failure are in scope.
test_design_notes: The // @panic marker asserts runtime failure at the cast; no explicit panic statement is required.
